# Learning Event Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LearningEventType`](gmeow-LearningEventType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LearningEventType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/learning`](../../slices/learning.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The variety of a learning event — a value vocabulary spanning concept-formation, skill-acquisition, being-taught, consolidation, transfer, and unlearning: [`gmeow:learningConceptFormation`](../individuals/gmeow-learningConceptFormation.md), [`gmeow:learningSkillAcquisition`](../individuals/gmeow-learningSkillAcquisition.md), [`gmeow:learningBeingTaught`](../individuals/gmeow-learningBeingTaught.md), [`gmeow:learningConsolidation`](../individuals/gmeow-learningConsolidation.md), [`gmeow:learningTransfer`](../individuals/gmeow-learningTransfer.md), [`gmeow:learningUnlearning`](../individuals/gmeow-learningUnlearning.md). Its members are individuals, never subclasses ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), more than one may co-apply to a single event, and the set is OPEN — a variety not among the seeds is a fresh [`gmeow:LearningEventType`](gmeow-LearningEventType.md) individual. The dedicated learning analogue of the inference slice's [`gmeow:InferenceMode`](gmeow-InferenceMode.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LearningEventType`](gmeow-LearningEventType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the variety of a [`gmeow:LearningEvent`](gmeow-LearningEvent.md) — the open set of learning kinds (acquisition, being-taught, consolidation, transfer, unlearning, concept-formation) that [`gmeow:learningType`](../properties/gmeow-learningType.md) draws from; mint a fresh individual for a variety not seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing it to add a variety — its members are individuals and the set is extended by minting, not subclassing ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) — and avoid forcing exactly one variety onto every event; a transfer that also consolidates is both [`gmeow:learningTransfer`](../individuals/gmeow-learningTransfer.md) and [`gmeow:learningConsolidation`](../individuals/gmeow-learningConsolidation.md) ([`gmeow:learningType`](../properties/gmeow-learningType.md) is non-functional).

### How to use

- Reference the seeded [`gmeow:LearningEventType`](gmeow-LearningEventType.md) individuals from a [`gmeow:LearningEvent`](gmeow-LearningEvent.md) via [`gmeow:learningType`](../properties/gmeow-learningType.md), attaching as many as genuinely apply; treat the bridges ([`gmeow:learningTransfer`](../individuals/gmeow-learningTransfer.md) → inference [`gmeow:Analogy`](gmeow-Analogy.md), [`gmeow:learningConceptFormation`](../individuals/gmeow-learningConceptFormation.md) → the concepts slice) as documented routing rather than new axioms.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:learningSkillAcquisition`](../individuals/gmeow-learningSkillAcquisition.md) a [`gmeow:LearningEventType`](gmeow-LearningEventType.md).
